issues.what: Timetable breaks from ch3 on: ch1 has tunnel entry 19:12 and the slide at 19:20, but ch3-8 put the fall (and lamps out) at 19:12; ch4 says the train entered the tunnel at 19:08, the minute it stood at Barog
issues.quote: The train entered the tunnel at nineteen oh eight. The fall came at nineteen twelve.

issues.what: Geography wrong again: after Dharampur the train reaches Solan on the way down to Kalka; also the buried portal is called the Barog end (ch2, ch3, ch6, ch8), yet Barog station is behind the train, and ch8 breaks through from the Barog end though the Dharampur gang digs the 'south mouth'

The wire changes wording: ch2 reads 'CERTIFICATES SIGNED GREWAL FORGER TRAVELS WITH ME...', ch6-8 read 'KOHLI FORGED GREWAL CERTIFICATES', which names the killer outright; ch8 re-tells finding it by match light when the lamps went out, not at 06:30
issues.quote: KOHLI FORGED GREWAL CERTIFICATES STOP HOLD FILE STOP BHALLA.

issues.what: The Major's plea is made again ('I ask again now') and misplaced 'At Barog'; ch7 says it was made when she showed him the certificates. He also answers the unasked question himself in ch6 ('I signed without reading a word'), and her final wire states it
issues.quote: At Barog I asked you to leave one question unasked.

issues.what: Seating contradicts everything after: coupes are locked and Bhalla, the Major, Hale and Rosalind share the four-berth, Bhalla drinks and drops the flask beside Rosalind at the slide; from ch2 he is bolted in coupe A, Hale 'heard him through the wall', Kohli rode with him Solan side, and Rosalind questions others about events she sat through
issues.quote: Coupes are locked this trip. Orders.

issues.what: Unfair, shifting solution: the veronal is the Major's (ch3, six short) but becomes Bhalla's own case with five missing and Kohli's three; the sliding pencil is never planted before ch7 (ch2's search lists a fountain pen) and its logic has the engine toward Shimla; the ch2 frost scratch is never paid off
issues.quote: From Bhalla's own medicine case. You had opened it that morning at Shimla

issues.what: Solan has four versions: Bhalla at the counter (ch1), boy to the window (ch3-4), Bhalla rinsing and adding brandy at the stall (ch6), Kohli carrying two cups (ch7); the Major alibis Kohli 18:35-18:42 at the telegraph office, covering the 18:38 dosing
issues.quote: From eighteen thirty five to eighteen forty two, by my watch.

issues.what: The rinsed flask contradicts ch2 (a last drop spilled, smell of coffee) and ch7 (emptied at Barog); ch5 says the door was unbolted at 19:15, ch7 bolted at 19:09
issues.quote: Bhalla rinsed it himself at Solan after the coffee, out of habit turned strange

issues.what: The Major signs the certificates on the train after Solan, contradicting ch3 (signed 1960) and the beat that they came to him via Kohli
issues.quote: I signed the margin as witness to his signature, nothing more.

issues.what: Brief's planned-moment wording pasted into dialogue (again in ch7)
issues.quote: Every lamp in first class goes out at once. You remember?

issues.what: Bitter almonds is the cyanide tell, not veronal; misleads the fair-play reader (again in ch6)
issues.quote: almonds left too long in a tin

issues.what: Real brands/businesses; also a 'dining car at Shimla' the toy train does not have
issues.quote: reach Paris Match and my studio

issues.what: Time slips: 'two days of silence' for one night; ch7 'yesterday morning' for the same day
issues.quote: Kalka came with noise after two days of silence.

praise: Rosalind is a fine detective voice, counting steps and sleepers to steady herself, and the Barog refreshment room shut since 1 December is a clean, fair clue when it lands in ch4.

issues.quote: This fish fine pass my husband's Benz, oh.

issues.what: The clue's logic says 'after five'; the flawless gloss proves no one touched the hatch after two
issues.quote: It had not been touched after five.

issues.what: A lawyer in a court wig at a family compound in the evening
Typo (missing space) and a present-tense slip in past narration
issues.quote: her apprentice,Yaw, had dropped a rag inside

praise: The varnish clue now works: the hatch empty at 11, Comfort alone 12:45-1:15, the tail sealed at 2, paper caught under flawless gloss. It is shown by lamplight before it is explained, and Gifty's turn at the end is a warm surprise.
